executive_summary: We have a login and onboarding crisis: 51 high-severity auth/registration complaints at Lidl Plus versus 2 at REWE, and users are discovering broken sessions at the till where our loyalty value evaporates. Meanwhile, REWE just shipped two major regressions — they stripped voice input and barcode scanning from their shopping list, and removed multi-store map view — handing us open windows in categories where they previously led. Fix the auth funnel in the next sprint and ship a voice-enabled shopping list within the quarter; these two moves protect our core and steal REWE's lost ground before they patch.

product_health.overall_verdict: Lidl Plus is in crisis on core funnels — authentication, onboarding, and post-update stability are bleeding loyal users at the moment of purchase.

critical_issues.what_is_happening: SMS codes don't arrive, OAuth callback only works when Chrome is the default browser, and sessions expire silently — users find out at the checkout when discounts no longer apply.
critical_issues.business_impact: This is direct loyalty-program churn at the highest-value moment. 36 high-severity complaints versus 1 at REWE. Every failed login at the till is a customer who concludes Lidl Plus is worthless.
critical_issues.user_voice_de: Ich stehe an der Kasse und plötzlich bin ich ausgeloggt — die Rabatte sind weg. SMS-Code kommt nie an. Nie wieder.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Replace external-browser OAuth handoff with in-app webview, add email magic-link as SMS fallback, and extend session lifetime with silent refresh.

critical_issues.what_is_happening: Registration fails with missing SMS codes, 'capacity exceeded' errors, Firefox incompatibility, and dozens of retry attempts before users give up.
critical_issues.business_impact: 15 reviews averaging ★1.33 with 87% high-severity. Every blocked registration is a permanently lost loyalty member — and REWE requires no account, so the comparison is brutal.
critical_issues.user_voice_de: 15 Versuche, kein Code, dann 'Kapazität überschritten'. Ich gebe auf.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Ship email magic-link registration as the default path; keep SMS as a fallback, not the gate.

critical_issues.what_is_happening: Post-update regressions: blank Profile screen, partner benefits failing, prospect view crashes, dropped support for older Android devices.
critical_issues.business_impact: 62 complaints, 77% high-severity, ★1.94 — users explicitly say they're switching to competitors. Our release QA is shipping regressions to production.
critical_issues.user_voice_de: Nach dem Update geht das Profil nicht mehr auf. Deinstalliert. Ich nehme jetzt Aldi.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Ship a targeted hotfix for Profile/partner-benefits regression this week; institute a pre-release smoke-test gate for the top 5 user flows.

critical_issues.what_is_happening: Manually activated coupons fail to apply at checkout, and the per-item activation flow is tedious and unrewarding.
critical_issues.business_impact: 31 complaints averaging ★1.9. Coupons are the core value proposition of Lidl Plus — when they fail, the whole app fails.
critical_issues.user_voice_de: Coupon aktiviert, an der Kasse zieht er nicht ab. Wofür dann die App?
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Auto-activate all eligible coupons by default; only require opt-in for promotions with explicit terms.

critical_issues.what_is_happening: Search returns absurd results (Lachs → Gartenmöbel), receipt search was removed, EV charging and QR scanner are buried in submenus.
critical_issues.business_impact: 18 complaints, 33% high-severity. Search failure trains users to stop opening the app for anything beyond coupons.
critical_issues.user_voice_de: Ich suche Lachs und bekomme Gartenmöbel. Ernsthaft?
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Replace current search with unified product+receipt+category bar pinned to home; restore receipt search.

product_health.what_users_value: When it works, users value the coupon-and-receipt loyalty bundle and digital pfand — these are the differentiators worth protecting. The in-store integration (when stable) is genuinely loved versus REWE's brochure-style app.

where_we_lead.finding: REWE's app is perceived as a brochure with no ordering, delivery, or account management — 26 complaints. We at least have a transactional surface via Lidl Pay and partner benefits.
where_we_lead.how_to_protect: Fix Lidl Pay on Android 17 immediately and expand pickup/click-and-collect entry points before REWE closes the gap.

where_we_lead.finding: We have digital receipts, Scan&Go, pfand integration, and partner benefits — REWE has almost none of this. Our average rating here (★2.91) beats REWE on substance.
where_we_lead.how_to_protect: Cache receipts locally for 90 days; reduce gamification noise that distracts from core in-store flows.

where_we_lead.finding: REWE users explicitly complain they have no scan-at-checkout coupon mechanism at all. Our coupons are buggy but they exist — a thin lead.
where_we_lead.how_to_protect: Auto-activate eligible coupons and fix the apply-at-checkout failures so the lead becomes real, not nominal.

where_we_trail.finding: Even after REWE's regression, their list is richer than ours — we have a rudimentary list with no prospect integration, no sorting, and crashes. Our ★3.25 hides a tiny sample (4 reviews) versus 15 active REWE complaints about features we don't even offer.
where_we_trail.risk_if_ignored: Shopping list is the highest-frequency engagement surface in a grocery app. We cede daily active usage to REWE the moment they re-ship voice input.

where_we_trail.finding: REWE requires no account at all. Our broken auth funnel is not just a bug — it's a strategic disadvantage against an app users can open and use immediately.
where_we_trail.risk_if_ignored: Casual shoppers who hit our SMS wall never come back; REWE captures them by default.

where_we_trail.finding: REWE users praise the brand's privacy-conscious image even when complaining. Our mandatory phone/birthday/address registration draws explicit spam-call accusations.
where_we_trail.risk_if_ignored: Privacy is becoming a purchase driver in DE; our data-greedy onboarding looks worse every quarter.

battlegrounds.area: Shopping list with voice and barcode
battlegrounds.situation: REWE removed voice input and barcode scanning in a recent update; their users are furious. We never built it. Neither app currently offers it.
battlegrounds.first_mover_advantage: Whoever ships voice + barcode + prospect-to-list integration first owns the daily-engagement category for the next 18 months.

battlegrounds.situation: REWE removed multi-store map view; we never built robust multi-store support. Both apps now lock users to one Filiale.
battlegrounds.first_mover_advantage: A two-week ship of multi-store switching captures commuters and travelers — a permanent retention bump.

battlegrounds.situation: Neither app has solved dark mode, tablet landscape, or decoupled language/region. Each has different gaps.
battlegrounds.first_mover_advantage: Power users are vocal advocates — shipping dark mode plus decoupled locale wins reviews and word-of-mouth cheaply.

strategic_opportunities.why_now: REWE shipped a regression in the last update removing voice input, barcode scanner, multi-market support, and PC-mobile sync. Their users are explicitly furious and looking for alternatives.
strategic_opportunities.competitor_vulnerability: 15 active REWE complaints demanding restoration. Their team will patch this — the window is one to two quarters at most.
strategic_opportunities.our_move: Ship voice-enabled, barcode-scanning shopping list with one-tap prospect-to-list this quarter. Market it explicitly to REWE defectors in app store description.

strategic_opportunities.why_now: REWE removed multi-store map view in the same regression cycle. Our users also complain about single-Filiale lock-in. Both bases want this and neither app offers it.
strategic_opportunities.competitor_vulnerability: Quick-win territory — small engineering scope, large UX payoff.
strategic_opportunities.our_move: Ship multi-store map with one-tap switching within 6 weeks; surface store-specific offers per location.

strategic_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the auth funnel before churn compounds
strategic_opportunities.why_now: 36 high-severity login complaints is not a backlog — it is active daily churn at the till. Every week we delay, the loyalty-program ROI degrades.
strategic_opportunities.competitor_vulnerability: REWE sidesteps this entirely by not requiring login. We must make our login frictionless or remove the requirement for casual flows.
strategic_opportunities.our_move: Email magic-link as primary auth path; in-app webview for OAuth; silent session refresh. Two-week sprint, hotfix priority.

strategic_opportunities.why_now: REWE's permission requests are drawing user pushback. We have an even bigger data-greed problem but also the opportunity to flip the narrative first.
strategic_opportunities.competitor_vulnerability: Neither app has shipped a 'minimal data' registration option.
strategic_opportunities.our_move: Add a 'lite' registration path (email only, optional phone) and just-in-time permission rationale; market as privacy-respecting.

sprint_recommendations.action: Ship email magic-link authentication and in-app webview OAuth; deprecate SMS as the primary gate.
sprint_recommendations.ab_test: A/B: magic-link primary versus SMS primary. Hypothesis: 50% reduction in login-failure support tickets and 30% lift in registration completion within 4 weeks.
sprint_recommendations.expected_impact: Stops active churn at checkout; unblocks the entire personalization and loyalty funnel.
sprint_recommendations.rationale: This is the single biggest revenue-protecting move on the board. Every day we delay, loyal customers conclude the app is broken at the till.

sprint_recommendations.action: Hotfix the post-update Profile/partner-benefits regression and dropped Android compatibility.
sprint_recommendations.ab_test: Pre/post measurement: crash-free session rate and 1-star review volume mentioning 'update'. Target: 40% reduction in 4 weeks.
sprint_recommendations.expected_impact: Stops the bleeding from our most recent release and restores baseline trust.
sprint_recommendations.rationale: Reputational triage. We are shipping regressions to production — this also requires a pre-release smoke-test gate going forward.

sprint_recommendations.action: Ship voice-enabled shopping list with barcode scanner and one-tap prospect-to-list integration.
sprint_recommendations.ab_test: A/B: new list versus current rudimentary list. Hypothesis: 30% lift in weekly active list users and 15% lift in 30-day retention.
sprint_recommendations.expected_impact: Captures REWE defectors and creates a daily-engagement surface we currently lack.
sprint_recommendations.rationale: Time-sensitive land grab. REWE will patch their regression — we have one quarter to plant our flag.

sprint_recommendations.action: Auto-activate all eligible coupons by default and fix apply-at-checkout failures.
sprint_recommendations.ab_test: A/B: auto-activate versus opt-in tap. Hypothesis: 30% lift in coupon redemption per active user over 2 weeks.
sprint_recommendations.expected_impact: Restores the core loyalty value proposition; reduces 'coupon didn't work' churn.
sprint_recommendations.rationale: Quick win on our most-complained-about value driver. Reduces friction without backend rebuild.

sprint_recommendations.action: Ship multi-store map with one-tap store switching and store-specific offer surfacing.
sprint_recommendations.ab_test: A/B: multi-store versus locked-Filiale. Hypothesis: 15% lift in weekly active sessions among store-finder users.
sprint_recommendations.expected_impact: Closes a battleground category before REWE patches their regression.
sprint_recommendations.rationale: Small engineering scope, large UX payoff, and competitive timing pressure — REWE will fix theirs eventually.

methodology: Analysis based on 600 Google Play Store reviews scraped from the DE market in May 2026 for Lidl Plus and REWE, with 432 retained after content-quality filtering. Themes were extracted and enriched via a multi-stage Claude pipeline producing per-theme severity, sentiment, and asymmetry signals. Limitations: single-platform snapshot (Android only), no longitudinal trend data, and potential distribution skew toward vocal complainants over silent satisfied users.

report_meta.data_basis: 432 substantive app store reviews (216 per app), German market, May 2026
